text.tspan: Time to new capacity is a chain of delays: shorten every link
During the surge: kubectl patch hpa web -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":40}}' · check maxReplicas · rate-limit / shed load at ingress · CDN cache · queue writes
Known events: pre-scale on a schedule (KEDA cron / CronJob / ASG schedule). HPA adds pods, not nodes.
HPA <unknown> CPU = metrics-server down or pods without CPU requests. More pods don't help a saturated database.
KEDA, Karpenter, Prometheus Adapter are NOT on your resume.
